title: Synthetic baseline IPW/AIPW and missing-outcome verification

target_trial.population: Generated independent units; not a biological trial
target_trial.eligibility: All generated units enrolled before the first decision
target_trial.assignment: Random assignment in the hypothetical target trial; the generated observational emulation depends on measured covariates

outcome.definition: Synthetic response with known additive coefficient 2

target_trial.analysis_plan: IPW/AIPW using baseline_x1 and baseline_x2; explicit IPCW for missing endpoints

emulation.eligibility_mapping: units.tsv eligible=1; selection occurs before treatment
emulation.assignment_mapping: Generated observational actions depend on recorded covariates; they do not represent randomization
emulation.time_zero_mapping: Relative time zero is the first decision; baseline observations precede it
emulation.strategy_mapping: treatments.tsv records verified actual binary actions over the specified intervals
emulation.outcome_mapping: observations.tsv response at time=90, with explicit NA endpoint rows
emulation.followup_mapping: Relative days 0 through 90; loss is recorded on the explicit time grid
emulation.estimand_mapping: Baseline A minus B individual-unit average treatment effect
emulation.analysis_mapping: Parametric propensity and outcome models; MAR outcome observation model; independent bootstrap
limitations: Synthetic numerical verification only; no observed biological measurements

identification.exchangeability: The generated data include measured common causes; real study identification still requires scientific review
identification.positivity: Fitted support is checked; probabilities are not clipped
identification.consistency: Binary actions and decision times are explicitly defined
identification.interference: Generated units do not interact; interference must be reviewed for real studies

missing_data_plan: Generated endpoint missingness is handled only by an explicitly selected policy; no automatic fill or row dropping

provenance.transformations: Synthetic numpy seed37115; independent statsmodels point-estimate reference in test resources
